result.topic_en: Calculations on a quartic form under a linear change of variables (killing certain coefficients), the condition for a plane to touch a surface written as a bordered Hessian-type determinant in the partial derivatives, and the factorisation of a ternary quadratic form restricted to a line into two linear factors involving the square root of a discriminant.

methods.what: Linear substitution of variables in a ternary quartic form and conditions killing coefficients
Conditions for direction (α'',β'',γ'') via first and second derivatives at a point on f=0
Determinant of Hessian matrix perturbed by λ times outer product of gradient (bordered Hessian expansion)
Restriction of a ternary quadratic form to a line by completing the square, splitting into linear factors with discriminant
Discriminant of the binary quadratic in y,z after substitution
